steps.js: JSON.stringify({thumbs:[...document.querySelectorAll('.thumb img')].map(i=>i.naturalWidth>0).filter(Boolean).length, thumbsAll:document.querySelectorAll('.thumb img').length, cards:document.querySelectorAll('.card').length, status:(document.getElementById('status')||{}).innerText, rolls:[...document.querySelectorAll('.card .src')].filter(x=>/Reading the market that ends/.test(x.textContent)).length, noreading:[...document.querySelectorAll('.card')].filter(c=>/No reading yet/.test(c.textContent)).length, expiry: !!document.querySelector('dt') && [...document.querySelectorAll('dt')].some(d=>d.textContent==='Market expiry')})
